summary: Revision 3 per human-review-2026-07-25-flat-routes: the /workspace/projects route and its page are deleted and the sidebar PROJECTS label now carries only a + action opening an inline create-project dialog; project workspaces moved to /workspace/<project-slug> with conversations at /workspace/<project-slug>/<thread_id>; opening a project redirects straight into a new conversation so the chat welcome renders beside the rail with no intermediate brief page; /workspace forwards into the first project or runs the first-run create flow. Project slugs are guarded against shadowing reserved workspace route segments. Known limitation: slug resolution is client-side against the active workspace's project list. Frontend lint, typecheck, unit tests, and production build all pass.
